title: The miracles that happened to Fr. James Altman
description: Bringing you the news from a traditional Catholic perspective. John-Henry Westen welcomes Fr. James Altman for a personal conversation about miracles, divine providence, and the Blessed Virgin Mary’s intercession. Moving beyond the controversies for which Fr. Altman is widely known, the interview explores his devotion to Our Lady of Fatima and the Miracle of the Sun, which he describes as his favorite miracle. … Priest: Leo won’t do Pachamama in Peru. He’ll let others do it Here is What the Triumph of the Immaculate Heart will Look Like The miracle that paved the way for Fulton Sheen’s beatification

title: Bishop Schneider: SSPX’s work ‘providential,’ sedevacantism ‘completely wrong’
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) — Bishop Athanasius Schneider has described the Society of St. Pius X (SSPX) as “a providential work for the Church” whose gradual integration would benefit the entire Body of Christ while declaring sedevacantism “completely wrong” and rejecting claims that the 1986 Assisi interreligious gathering belongs to the ordinary magisterium. In an exclusive interview with AdVaticanum recorded in connection with the 2026 Summorum Pontificum pilgrimage — during which Schneider celebrated Mass at the high altar of the Basilica of St. Mary Major after Vatican restrictions barred a pontifical liturgy in St. Peter’s — the auxiliary bishop of Astana addressed the ongoing canonical status of the SSPX after its July 1 episcopal consecrations, the 40th anniversary of the Assisi World Day of Prayer for Peace, and the theological errors of sede … Church history supplies examples of popes who erred in doctrine (Honorius, Liberius, John XXII), yet Christ continues to guide His Church even through unworthy pontiffs. The crisis remains “only a temporal situation.” Schneider distinguished legitimate resistance from disobedience. “Absolute obedience” is due to God alone; proclaiming absolute obedience to any human being, including the pope, “would be an error even a heresy.” He recalled St. Paul’s public resistance to St. Peter at Antioch (Galatians 2), noting that Saints Augustine and Thomas Aquinas taught the Holy Spirit permitted the incident to be recorded so that “when the clarity of faith is in danger … those who are subject in the Church have the right and even the duty to admonish the superiors … even the highest superior … out of love for the Church (and) for the dignity of the papal ministry.”

title: Ontario pushes for ‘optional’ digital ID
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) — The province of Ontario is moving one step closer to a digital identification system after announcing it plans to gradually phase in what it says are “optional” health cards and driver’s licenses for those who want them. The provincial government under Premier Doug Ford announced the plan a couple of days ago and says it will start with the Ontario Photo Card, an ID for people who do not have a driver’s license. … Canadians do not want digital IDs, as noted by Canada’s Privy Council research from 2023 , which indicated that there is strong public resistance to the use of digital IDs to access government services. Despite this, digital IDs and similar systems have long been pushed by globalist groups like the World Economic Forum, an organization with which Carney has extensive ties, under the guise of ease of access and security. Alberta and British Columbia already have forms of digital IDs.
